bug_semantics: atomic_agents/dashboard/serve.py DashboardHandler.do_GET takes urlparse(self.path).path and joins it into filesystem paths with no containment check, then _serve_file reads whatever exists. Three untrusted-path branches first appear together: GET /agents/<name> does agents_root / agent_name / dashboard.html; GET /_dashboard/<rel> does agents_root / path.lstrip('/'); a bare filename does agents_root / '_dashboard' / path.lstrip('/'). Literal '../' segments survive urlparse and pathlib joining, so requests such as GET /../../../../etc/hosts, GET /_dashboard/../../secret, or GET /agents/../../../secret read files outside agents_root. Default bind is 127.0.0.1:8765, but dashboard __main__ already exposes operator-settable --host (default 127.0.0.1), so a 0.0.0.0 bind exposes the read on the LAN; loopback remains reachable via DNS rebinding or co-located SSRF. CWE-22 arbitrary file read.
flaw_origin: The uncontained Path joins were first written when dashboard/serve.py itself was created in the public root commit. At that snapshot _io.py had only atomic_write/atomic_append_jsonl/cleanup_stale_tempfiles (no safe_resolve_under) and exceptions.py had no PathTraversalError. The later tab-route commit only maps fixed names such as /activity -> activity.html through the same _serve_file helper; it does not introduce the untrusted-path mechanism. safe_resolve_under was added later for other modules and was not applied to this handler until the GHSA patch.

reasoning: Vulnerability first: the dashboard HTTP handler served request-derived paths without resolving them under a root, which is a real CWE-22 file-read (advisory published/reviewed, not withdrawn; no CVE.org record because none was assigned). Lifecycle: 151bd93 created serve.py with the three untrusted joins and loopback-default plus --host; 08c5f6ab only added constant tab filenames and is a carrier, not the first write of the mechanism; 7088f4da added safe_resolve_under for other modules but left this handler unguarded through v1.0.0; ec474f4 (single-parent squash of #421) routes every served path through safe_resolve_under, 404s PathTraversalError, and rejects .. and separators on /agents/. BIC choice: smallest public first-write of the vulnerable lines is the root commit; parent-tree verification is against the empty tree (file absent); no reconstructable public squash members. AI second and BIC-only: the introducer object has human author/committer and no AI co-author/generated trailer; later AI on the tab feature and on the fix does not attribute the BIC.
